headline: ATEEZ's 'UP' enters Billboard Hot 100 at No. 90
sub: Their 3rd Hot 100 entry, the same week they topped the Billboard 200

points.title: What to know
items: Also No. 1 on Top Album Sales
World tour 'ZERO TO ALL' opens Jan 22 in Incheon
Tour heads to Japan, Europe and the Americas

source: Source: KQ Entertainment via Korean media
caption:
ATEEZ's 'UP' has entered the Billboard Hot 100 at No. 90!

It's the group's third song on the Hot 100, after 'Lemon Drop' and 'In Your Fantasy', and it lands the same week their 15th mini album 'GOLDEN HOUR : Part.6' debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 — their fourth chart-topper. "We won't lose sight of where we started," the members said, thanking ATINY. Next up: the 2027 world tour 'ZERO TO ALL', kicking off Jan 22–24 in Incheon.

📌 Source: KQ Entertainment via Korean media (Etoday, Sports Kyunghyang)
